description: CALCULATION. Use this when you need a date-by-date timeline of Snap's payout steps from a credited date: Pending to Available, the cash-out minimum, taxpayer verification, and the earliest day cash can reach the Payout Portal. Ranges stay ranges when the source gives a range. This is an estimate, not a promise. Do not use it to score eligibility (check_eligibility) or to list every rule (get_monetization_requirements).

inputSchema.description: CALCULATION tool. Dates Snap's payout steps from the day a reward was credited (the day it appeared in All Activity). Optional amount_usd is compared with the published cash-out minimum. Optional tax_info_verified says whether taxpayer verification is already finished. This tool does not look up an account. The result is an estimate, not a promise.

amount_usd.description: Available balance in USD, supplied by the caller. Omitted when unknown. Compared with the cash-out minimum from the rules database. Not a Snap pay rate.

credited_date.description: The day the reward appeared in All Activity, which is when Snap starts the pending clock. YYYY-MM-DD.

tax_info_verified.description: True when the caller says taxpayer verification is already finished. False when it is not. Omit when unknown. This service does not check a Snap account.

allOf.description: Fields present in every successful tool output.

newest_last_checked_at.description: Latest last_checked_at among rules in this response. Omitted when none of those rules have an unchanged-source check. Does not replace newest_verified_at.

oldest_last_checked_at.description: Earliest last_checked_at among rules in this response. Omitted when none of those rules have an unchanged-source check. Does not replace oldest_verified_at.

policy.description: Human-readable freshness policy, e.g. 'Sources are re-checked daily; a rule is listed as stale when the later of verified_at and last_checked_at is more than 7 days before the response date.'

rules_db_version.description: Monotonic version of the published rules set. Pattern YYYY-MM-DD.n

stale_rule_ids.description: Rules in this response whose later of verified_at and last_checked_at is older than the staleness window stated in `policy`. A missing last_checked_at does not count.

notice.description: Non-affiliation notice included in every response.

last_checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the latest automated check that found this source's official text unchanged. Omitted when no such check is recorded. Does not replace verified_at.

warnings.description: Plain strings. Omitted when empty. Calculation tools add a string when followers is 0 and view_time_hours_28d or spotlight_view_time_hours_28d is above 0, and when view_time_hours_28d exceeds 28 days × 24 hours × followers × 0.5. Those warnings say the figure is unusually high for your follower count, please check for a typo, and that view time can come from non-followers. They are never an error. FACT GET aliases append ignored query parameter notices to this same array. Spotlight hours above total view hours are HTTP 400 VALUE_INCONSISTENT rather than a warning.

cash_out_minimum_usd.description: The cash-out minimum copied from the rules database.

newest_last_checked_at.description: Latest last_checked_at among rules in this response. Omitted when none of those rules have an unchanged-source check. Does not replace newest_verified_at.

oldest_last_checked_at.description: Earliest last_checked_at among rules in this response. Omitted when none of those rules have an unchanged-source check. Does not replace oldest_verified_at.

policy.description: Human-readable freshness policy, e.g. 'Sources are re-checked daily; a rule is listed as stale when the later of verified_at and last_checked_at is more than 7 days before the response date.'

estimate_disclaimer.const: Snap may change this timing. This timeline is an estimate, not a promise.

items.description: FACT: a rule record as stored in the versioned rules database (approved records only).

changed_after.description: Inclusive start of an observed change window when the source does not state a single effective_date. Null when unknown. Additive.

changed_before.description: Inclusive end of an observed change window when the source does not state a single effective_date. Null when unknown. Additive.

date_note.description: How changed_after and changed_before were established. Null when there is no window note. Not a substitute for source_url.

effective_date_note.description: Present when effective_date is null because Snap did not publish a date. effective_date stays null.

iso_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 codes for each name in a country list, from the reviewed country map. Omitted unless this fact is a country list.

last_checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the latest automated check that found this rule's official source text unchanged. Omitted when no such check is recorded. Does not replace verified_at and is not a rule value.

program.description: Program identifier. Validated at runtime against programs present in the rules database; unknown values return UNKNOWN_PROGRAM. Examples: unified_monetization_program, snap_star, creator_subscriptions, brand_partnerships, payouts, tax, recommendation_eligibility, creator_monetization_policy, public_profile, lens_creator_rewards.

rule_type.description: Role of the rule, copied from the rules database. Omitted by older clients. Used to group answer pages.

meets_minimum.description: True when amount_usd meets the cash-out minimum. False when it does not. Null when amount_usd was omitted.

notice.const: HowToMakeMoneyOnSnapchat.com is an independent third party and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Snap Inc. Snapchat is a trademark of Snap Inc.
notice.description: Non-affiliation notice included in every response.

shortfall_usd.description: How far amount_usd is under the cash-out minimum. 0 when the minimum is met. Null when amount_usd was omitted.

last_checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the latest automated check that found this source's official text unchanged. Omitted when no such check is recorded. Does not replace verified_at.

range.description: True when the source gives a range, or when a latest date is not published.
